name: 阿里妈妈单元报表下载

steps.description: 等待账户报表页加载完成
在宿主页面主动请求鉴权接口

params.fn: (async function(){ const response = await fetch('https://one.alimama.com/member/checkAccess.json', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ bizCode: 'universalBP' }) }); const text = await response.text(); let payload; try { payload = JSON.parse(text); } catch { throw new Error('鉴权响应不是 JSON: ' + text.slice(0, 120)); } if (!response.ok) throw new Error('鉴权接口请求失败: HTTP ' + response.status); const csrfId = payload && payload.data && payload.data.accessInfo && payload.data.accessInfo.csrfId; const loginPointId = payload && payload.data && payload.data.loginPointId; if (!csrfId || !loginPointId) { throw new Error('检测到当前未登录阿里妈妈，请先登录后重试'); } return { csrfId: String(csrfId).trim(), loginPointId: String(loginPointId).trim(), response: payload }; })

steps.description: 创建单元报表下载任务

params.fn: (async function(context){ const auth = context.execute_authInfo || {}; const csrfId = auth.csrfId; const loginPointId = auth.loginPointId; if (!csrfId || !loginPointId) throw new Error('缺少阿里妈妈鉴权参数'); const url = new URL('https://one.alimama.com/report/createDownLoadTask.json'); url.searchParams.set('csrfId', csrfId); url.searchParams.set('bizCode', 'universalBP'); const body = { excelName: '单元报表_{{startTime}}_{{endTime}}', pageSize: 20, offset: 0, havingList: [], endTime: '{{endTime}}', from: 'pcBaseReport', unifyType: 'zhai', effectEqual: 15, startTime: '{{startTime}}', splitType: '{{splitType}}', bizCodeIn: ['onebpSearch'], queryFieldIn: ['adPv', 'click', 'charge', 'ctr', 'ecpc', 'alipayInshopAmt', 'alipayInshopNum', 'cvr', 'cartInshopNum', 'itemColInshopNum', 'shopColDirNum', 'colNum', 'itemColInshopCost'], vsType: 'week', vsTime: '{{endTime}}', searchValue: '', searchKey: 'strategyCampaignIdOrName', queryDomains: ['adgroup', 'date', 'campaign'], adzonePkgIdIn: ['114786650498', '114790550288'], fieldType: 'all', rptType: 'adgroup', parentAdcName: 'report_frame_adgroup', byPage: false, fromRealTime: false, source: 'async_dowdload', csrfId, bizCode: 'universalBP', loginPointId }; const response = await fetch(url.toString(), { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }); const text = await response.text(); let payload; try { payload = JSON.parse(text); } catch { throw new Error('创建下载任务响应不是 JSON: ' + text.slice(0, 120)); } if (!response.ok) throw new Error('创建下载任务失败: HTTP ' + response.status); const taskId = payload && payload.data && payload.data.taskId; if (!taskId) throw new Error('创建下载任务未返回 taskId: ' + JSON.stringify(payload).slice(0, 200)); return { taskId, response: payload }; })

steps.description: 轮询单元报表下载链接

params.fn: (async function(context){ const auth = context.execute_authInfo || {}; const task = context.execute_downloadTask || {}; const taskId = task.taskId; if (!auth.csrfId || !auth.loginPointId || !taskId) throw new Error('缺少轮询下载链接所需参数'); const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); await sleep(30000); let lastPayload = null; for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 25; attempt += 1) { const url = new URL('https://bpcommon.alimama.com/commonapi/report/async/getDownloadUrl.json'); url.searchParams.set('taskId', taskId); url.searchParams.set('bizCode', 'universalBP'); url.searchParams.set('csrfId', auth.csrfId); url.searchParams.set('loginPointId', auth.loginPointId); const response = await fetch(url.toString(), { method: 'GET', credentials: 'include' }); const text = await response.text(); let payload; try { payload = JSON.parse(text); } catch { throw new Error('下载链接响应不是 JSON: ' + text.slice(0, 120)); } lastPayload = payload; const downloadUrl = payload && payload.data && payload.data.result && payload.data.result.downloadUrl; if (downloadUrl) return { downloadUrl, attempt, response: payload }; if (!response.ok) throw new Error('轮询下载链接失败: HTTP ' + response.status); await sleep(5000); } throw new Error('轮询超时，未生成下载链接: ' + JSON.stringify(lastPayload).slice(0, 200)); })
